sample_title: Oryza sativa Nipponbare WT root, low phosphate (25 uM), mock inoculation (water), replicate 1
sample_description: Rice (Oryza sativa L. ssp. Japonica cv. Nipponbare) root RNA-seq. Genotype: wild type.
